summary: Independent review of Jin Shu 86 units s0211–s0420 (owned slice) against the sealed Chinese, not the English. Conventional AD labels used here are reign-year labels, not month/day conversions: Min Jianxing 1–4 = 313–316, Jianxing 6 (Liang continued) = 318, Taixing 1 = 318, Taixing 3 = 320, Yongchang opens 322 (era runs into early 323), Taining 1–3 = 323–325, Xianhe 1 = 326. Academia Sinica defaults to Julian before 1582; no owned row has a verified month/day that needed proleptic-Gregorian normalization. Most chronology is supported: 是歲 太興 / 建興六年 relief acts at 318; 太興三年 plot/deaths at 320; 建興四年 enfeoffment at 316; 二年 after 建興初 as Jianxing 2 = 314; 歲餘/明年/未幾 kept as open after-320 / onOrBefore-322 sequences; 建興初 / 永昌初 / 咸和初 kept as era-opening bounds; Jin Shu vs Tongjian Taining clashes (Mao death, Jun investiture, Yuan Di death-news, Fuhan/Wang Zhi) left unresolved; sui ages (十歲, 年十八, 年四十八) not converted to birth years; later citations split into undated attestation plus retrospective-reference and kept out of life hints.
